item.tib: bzang spyod kyi 'grel pa bzhi'i don bsdus nas brjed byang du byas pa
item.coloph: 'phags pa bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam la slob dpon phyogs kyi glang po 'grel pa mdzad pa dang / slob dpon shAkya bshes gnyen gyi 'grel pa mdzad pa dang / sangs rgyas grags pas 'grel pa madza pa dang / rgyan bzang pos TI ka mdzad pa rnam pas bzhi'i don dang / 'phral du mkhan po dag las thos pa dang / mdo sde nas 'byung ba dang yang sbyar te/ bshad pa brda phrad sla bar brjed byang du byas pa rdzogs so
